title: Fix FindDependencyCycles duplication and complexity
description:
## G-7 (from kb-graph-rag-audit)

The DFS in FindDependencyCycles restarts a fresh `seen` HashSet (cloned, not shared) at every recursive call and every top-level starting node, rather than sharing one global visited-set with proper recursion-stack tracking. This is correct but needlessly expensive on dense depends-on: graphs. A single cycle A→B→C→A gets reported multiple times, once per rotation.

### Detailed Steps
1. Rewrite using a single shared "on current recursion stack" set plus a "fully explored, no cycle" memo set — standard O(V+E) cycle-detection DFS
2. Canonicalize found cycles (rotate to start at lexicographically smallest node ID) before adding to results list, and dedupe

### Test Plan
- Single 4-node cycle reachable from 3 different starting tags produces exactly 1 entry, not 3 rotated copies
- Synthetic dense dependency graph (500 nodes, avg out-degree 5) completes in bounded time
